name: Amazon Interview Experience
summary: Write-up of an Amazon interview: two coding rounds with array and binary search tree questions, plus the BST solution code.
description: An interview-experience write-up on GeeksforGeeks for an Amazon interview: round one asks for numbers occurring once in a right-rotated array, round two is a binary search tree path-weight problem with a worked example and code. Links out to the site's DSA and system design tutorials.
